short: Returning money to a customer for a cancelled or returned sale.
seoTitle: Refund — Meaning and Example for Businesses
metaDescription: A refund returns money to a customer for a cancelled order, a returned item or a service not delivered. Part of the free Setu business glossary.
definition: A refund returns money to a customer for a cancelled order, a returned item or a service not delivered. It reverses the payment and, where a tax invoice was issued, should be accompanied by a credit note.
bodyHtml:
Why Refund matters

Refunds handled informally leave sales overstated and GST paid on money you gave back. Handled slowly, they also turn a recoverable complaint into a review and a chargeback.

How Refund works in practice

Refund to the original payment method where possible, issue the credit note against the original invoice, and record the reason. Refund reasons are one of the most useful quality signals a business collects.

faq.question: Do I need a credit note for every refund?
faq.answer: For any refund against a tax invoice, yes — that is what reverses the tax.

faq.question: Should refunds go back to the original payment mode?
faq.answer: Wherever possible. It reduces disputes and keeps reconciliation clean.
